**[action]** Diagnosed `src/bus.ts` `emit`:


`forEach` ignores the promise each callback returns, so every handler started at once, `emit` resolved immediately, and a throw/reject became an unhandled rejection instead of rejecting `emit`. Replaced it with an ordered sequential loop over a snapshot:

```ts
const list = [...(this.handlers.get(event) ?? [])];
for (const handler of list) { await handler(payload); }
```

- hook never runs: `emit` returned before handlers settled, so work was dropped when the caller moved on (and any handler after an ignored throw still ran, masking errors);
- failing hook silently ignored: the rejected promise from an `async` `forEach` callback was never connected to `emit`'s promise.
